top_signals.title: China, North Korea Open Long-Stalled Bridge, Boosting Trade
top_signals.summary: North Korea has opened two major bridges connecting it to key trading partners in the last month, with the latest — a bridge link to China — inaugurated Thursday after a more than decade-long delay.
